paite: Huchiin Bildad Sua miin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

paite: Thute zonga bangtan thang kam ding na hia ua? Ngaihtuah in, huaikhit chiangin ka pau ding uh.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

paite: Bangdia gamsa banga sima oma, na mitmuh ua sianglou honghi ka hi ua?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

paite: Nang na hehna kipumpei nang jiakin lei mangngilhin a om diam? ahihkeileh a mun akipatin suangpi suan khiakin a om diam?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?

paite: A hi, migilou vakna mihsakin a om dinga, a meiek a tang kei ding.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked shall be put out, The spark of his fire shall not shine.

paite: A puanin ah vakna a mial dia, a tunga a khawnvak mihsak ahi ding.
english: The light shall be dark in his tent. His lamp above him shall be put out.

paite: A hatna kalsuante hihtuailuai ahi dia, huan amah thupha genin amah a paikhe ding hi.
english: The steps of his strength shall be shortened. His own counsel shall cast him down.

paite: Amah khe mahmahin lah len sungah amah a pai lut ngala, huan len ah a kiawksak hi.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

paite: Thangin a khetulah a man dia, thangin amah a len ding hi.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

paite: Leiah amaha dingin a ba selin a oma, lampi ah amah adin thang.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him in the way.

paite: Kihtakhuaiten ning chiteng ah amah a lausak dia, a khetul ah a delhjui ding hi.
english: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall chase him at his heels.

paite: A hatna gilkial nekin a om dia, huan tuahsiatna a khawlna dingin mansain a om ding.
english: His strength shall be famished. Calamity shall be ready at his side.

paite: A pumpi hiangte a negai dinga, ahi, ahiangte sihna ta masapenin a negai ding.
english: The members of his body shall be devoured. The firstborn of death shall devour his members.

paite: A suan a puanin akipan zungkalh khiakin a om dia; huan lauhuainate kumpipa kianga piin a om ding.
english: He shall be rooted out of his tent where he trusts. He shall be brought to the king of terrors.

paite: Amaha hi lou a puanin sungah teng a om ding: a tenna ah kat theh jakin a om ding hi.
english: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur shall be scattered on his habitation.

paite: Nuailamah a zungte a keu dia, huan tunglamah ahiang sat khiak ahi ding.
english: His roots shall be dried up beneath. Above shall his branch be cut off.

paite: Lei akipanin a theihgige a mangthang ding; huan kongzing ah min a neikei ding.
english: His memory shall perish from the earth. He shall have no name in the street.

paite: Khovak akipanin khomial ah hawllut ahi dinga, huan khovel akipana delh khiak.
english: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

paite: A mite lakah tapa a neikei dia tapa tapa leng: a omna ah kuamah omlai a om kei ding hi.
english: He shall have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

paite: Tumlama omten a ni lamdang a sa ding ua, suahlama omte hihlaua a om bang un.Huchibang mi diktatloute tennate ahi petmaha, huan hiai Pathian theilou mi mun ahi hi.
english: Those who come after shall be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

paite: Huchibang mi diktatloute tennate ahi petmaha, huan hiai Pathian theilou mi mun ahi hi.
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
